public_declarations.signature:
theorem cls_iff {M : ℕ} (D : RayData K M) (c : D.G) (B I : Ideal (𝓞 K))
    (hB : IsCoprime B (Ideal.span {(M : 𝓞 K)})) (hB0 : B ≠ ⊥) (hc : D.cls B = c⁻¹)
    (hI : IsCoprime I (Ideal.span {(M : 𝓞 K)})) (hI0 : I ≠ ⊥) :
    D.cls I = c ↔ ∃ x : 𝓞 K, x - 1 ∈ Ideal.span {(M : 𝓞 K)} ∧ Ideal.span {x} = I * B

theorem lattice_bij (N B : Ideal (𝓞 K)) (hB : IsCoprime B N) (e : Module.Basis (Fin 2) ℤ ↥(N * B))

    ∃ f : ℤ × ℤ ≃ {x : 𝓞 K // x ∈ B ∧ x - 1 ∈ N},
      ∀ p, (f p : 𝓞 K) = x₀ + p.1 * (e 0 : 𝓞 K) + p.2 * (e 1 : 𝓞 K)

    (K : Type) [Field K] [NumberField K] (d M : ℕ) (x : K)
    (hp : d.Prime) (hd : d % 4 = 3) (hd100 : 100 ≤ d)
    (hx : x ^ 2 = -(d : K)) (h2 : Module.finrank ℚ K = 2) (hM : 3 ≤ M)

      1 ≤ α ∧ 1 ≤ γ ∧ α * γ = d * (M : ℝ) ^ 4 / 4 ∧

public_declarations.signature: theorem aRay_eq_ncard_qForm : ∀ (K : Type) [Field K] [NumberField K] (d M : ℕ) (x : K), d.Prime → d % 4 = 3 → 100 ≤ d → x ^ 2 = -(d : K) → Module.finrank ℚ K = 2 → 3 ≤ M → ∀ D : RayData K M, ∀ g : D.G, ∃ α γ l θ₁ θ₂ : ℝ, 1 ≤ α ∧ 1 ≤ γ ∧ α * γ = d * (M : ℝ) ^ 4 / 4 ∧ (∀ v : ℤ × ℤ, ∃ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n ∧ qForm α γ l θ₁ θ₂ v = n) ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, aRay D g n = (({v : ℤ × ℤ | qForm α γ l θ₁ θ₂ v = n}.ncard : ℕ) : ℝ)

exact_main_inputs: K is a number field; d and M are natural numbers; x belongs to K.
D is the full actual RayData K M from the previous constructive quotient; g is one of its ray classes. Canonical rayData supplies D, without an analytic premise.
proved_main_output: A genuine equivalence Phi : Z^2 ≃ {I : Ideal O_K | IsCoprime I (M) and D.cls I = g}.
The original all-n count identity aRay D g n = ncard {v | qForm(v)=n}, obtained by the same Phi image and injectivity.
construction_ledger: Construct rational basis 1,x and field conjugation; integrality of trace/norm, squarefree denominator and parity produce the full integral generator (1+x)/2.
Construct an embedding with x mapped to i*sqrt(d); no embedding or basis premise.
Choose B in the inverse ray class from the proved cls_surj. cls_iff yields the literal principal relation (generator)=I*B.
gen_bij retains congruent-to-one units as a factor; unit_eq_one proves this factor trivial from M>=3 in the degree-two totally complex field.
Bezout produces x0 in B with x0=1 modM; the actual basis of (M)*B parametrizes exactly that affine coset.
Integral row reduction preserves the same lattice and area while supplying the genuine first-vector squared norm bound.
The exact area is M^2*Norm(B)*sqrt(d)/2. Divide the squared embedded generator norm by Norm(B) to obtain the original ideal norm.
Expose Phi and the norm identity in exists_quadratic_norm_coordinates; only then derive the source count equality.
